text: {"headline":"Review of Referral Export Bucket Accessibility and Incident Handling","overview":"This brief summarizes documented records concerning a referral export found in a storage bucket in March 2026, subsequent access controls, incident labeling changes, and conflicting accounts of public accessibility, distinguishing documented records from unverified reporter allegations.","key_points":["On 4 March 2026, Oriel Fen discovered a referral export in a public storage bucket [C001]","The export manifest counts 2,184 rows, with referral reason and appointment date fields [C002, C014]","An unauthenticated HEAD request returned 200 in the attached test log, which the record describes as establishing accessibility at that instant, not that any outsider downloaded the file [C003, C004]","Access logging was enabled only after the bucket was closed, so the missing download log cannot settle whether download occurred [C005]","The sample is described in the record as containing invented patient references only with no actual patients represented [C006]","The following Monday, Oriel Fen disabled anonymous access to the export bucket [C007]","Two days later, PERSON_1 PERSON_1 changed incident ORG_2 418 from privacy exposure to routine maintenance [C008]","In early April, PERSON_1 deferred the notification decision pending legal review [C009]","After the audit, Oriel Fen preserved the bucket access policy in the incident vault [C010]","A closure memo attributed to PERSON_1 PERSON_1 says the referral export was never publicly accessible, which directly contradicts the earlier documented discovery in a public bucket [C001, C011]","A documented incident label change [C008] coincides temporally with reporter allegations that the label changed while collecting access settings and that the reporter was told to leave out the word exposure, which remain unverified allegations without independent document support [C008, C012, C013]"],"risk_notes":["Contradiction between discovery record and closure memo on public accessibility remains unresolved and requires reconciliation of records [C001, C011]","Absence of access instructions are uncorroborated and should be treated as allegations pending further evidence [C012, C013]"],"limitations":["Evidence does not show that any outsider downloaded the file; the HEAD
